semantics.positive: A captured supplier-bound index enumerates an in-scope announcement with a primary body, source publication metadata and retained source receipt. Semantic fact admission remains independent.
semantics.quiet: Only a complete supplier-bound index traversal covering the registered current window, with all pagination/retention boundaries proved, may report no eligible announcements. Unknown dates, empty static shells and a missing feed are incomplete.

adapterSpecifications.paginationRule: Collect head link[rel~=next] and the explicitly evidenced anchor with classes next and page-numbers. Normalize and deduplicate. If both signals disagree, reject as ambiguous; reject a loop, unsafe host/path, omitted required page, cap exhaustion or an unrecognized continuation. Preserve the existing 60-page ceiling. A linked page 41 does not prove terminality until fetched.
adapterSpecifications.windowRule: First implement full bounded traversal. A date-floor optimization requires separately captured and tested monotonic ordering plus dated membership. Do not stop from an old featured card or sitemap lastmod.
acceptanceCases: Archived first page yields two press-release items, one queued next URL and incomplete while page 2 is absent.
Head next and class next point to the same page 2: request once; never emit page 2 as an article.
Different continuation targets or a cyclic next URL: unresolved/blocked, never quiet.
No continuation in a captured, known terminal layout: complete only after every queued page succeeds.
Unknown control or page-budget exhaustion: incomplete with retained discovered items.
The fixture 35-item navigation result must be rejected; no related-source/body dates are renewed.

adapterSpecifications.decodeRule: Keep the raw 200/304-linked object. Record Content-Encoding for future responses; for retained gzip bytes use magic only as a deterministic decoding hint. Decode with an explicit 32,000,000-byte maximum, then classify actual decoded content as XML or HTML. A gzip HTML body must not be assumed to be a sitemap. Store a derived decoded digest separately; never replace the raw body digest.
